verdict.rationale: Postman offers a documented public API for managing assets, a CLI for running collections/CI, and a live MCP server for AI-agent integration, giving strong programmatic surface area (postman-docs-5, postman-probe-6, postman-probe-7). However, some UI-native features like live collaboration sessions, workspace roles/permissions, and theming/UI-specific workflows aren't clearly exposed via API/CLI, and community feedback raises concerns about cloud lock-in and forced account/data sync that constrain fully independent API-driven use (postman-comm-13, postman-comm-17).
